title.suggested: Wray's Column: McCoole lends Allen money to bet against him

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch recalled that just before a title fight, Mike McCoole offered Tom Allen a $500 side bet and, when Allen said he had only $300, lent him the other $200 to cover it.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Tuesday, October 22, 1935, page 3B.

facts.fact: In the ring before a title fight, Mike McCoole bet Allen $500 more that he would win; Allen said he had only $300 and McCoole lent him the other $200 to cover the bet

notes: Anecdote told 65 years after the event; which Allen-McCoole fight is not stated.
